definitions.explanation: The quality of being oily or greasy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{脂|あぶら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く→取り除く：04222_torinozoku⟧。
examples.english: To remove the fat from the meat.

examples.japanese: {脂|あぶら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧のった⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧。
examples.english: A fish with good fat content.
To wipe the oil off one's face.

examples.japanese: {脂|あぶら}っこい⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧。

examples.english: This meat has a lot of fat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{脂|あぶら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気|き}になる→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧。
examples.english: In summer, the oiliness on my face bothers me.

notes:
{脂|あぶら} refers to animal fat or body oil.

KANJI DISTINCTION:
- {脂|あぶら}: animal fat, body oil
- {油|あぶら}: oil (vegetable, petroleum, etc.)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {脂|あぶら}がのる (to be fatty/well-marbled)
- {脂|あぶら}っこい (greasy, oily)
- {脂肪|しぼう}: fat (scientific term)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {皮脂|ひし}: sebum (skin oil)
- {脂身|あぶらみ}: fatty meat
